Layer 1 · Eligibility

Can you buy?

Five questions. The output is an indicative position, not a permission — the permission comes from a district housing bureau, in writing, and this tool tells you what to ask them.

1 What is your current residence permit for?
2 How long have you worked or studied in mainland China, with documents?
3 Will you buy in the city where you work or study?
4 Does anyone in your household already own residential property in China?
5 What kind of unit are you considering?

Then do this

Whatever this says, the next step is the same: take your documents to the district housing bureau and ask for an eligibility confirmation in writing. The script is on the verification page.

How to verify

Why five questions

These are the five facts the housing bureau will actually establish. Everything else — budget, district, taste — comes later, and is irrelevant if any of these fails.

What a calculator cannot decide

The number is the start of the argument, not the end of it.

This tool answers one question. The framework is where that answer is tested against the other four.
